blocks.text: Carl Sagan dedicated his life to understanding the universe and our place within it, inspiring millions of people to become more interested in worlds beyond our own. Drawing on archives and interviewing those closest to him, this touching tribute interweaves Sagan’s pioneering research – and boundless passion for activism and advocacy – with his complex private life and the personal and working relationship that would define his later life.

blocks.text: By turns exhilarating and intimate, this documentary portrait charts nomadic cyclist Max Schnell’s attempt to complete an extreme journey through some of Europe’s highest mountain passes.
Shaped by the tidal rhythms of British Columbia’s oyster farms, this richly cinematic documentary, shot on 35mm, exists where labour, scientific inquiry and the living world meet.

The film collective Cosmic Salon (Jack Auen and Kevin Walker) make their beguiling and assured feature debut, guiding us through hidden histories and uncanny landscapes of belief, mystery and the unknown.
